name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router: Server/Client Components, streaming, parallel/intercepting routes, SSR/SSG, caching, data fetching, Server Actions.

Modes: Server=secrets/data/heavy computation; Client=interactivity/hooks/browser APIs; Static=build time; Dynamic=request/personalized; Streaming=progressive slow/large pages.

Files: layout.tsx shared wrapper; page.tsx UI; loading.tsx Suspense loading; error.tsx boundary; not-found.tsx 404; route.ts API; template.tsx remounted layout; default.tsx parallel fallback; opengraph-image.tsx OG image.

Patterns: `app/layout.tsx`: `Inter` from `next/font/google`, `Providers`, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, `<body className={inter.className}>`. `app/page.tsx`: Server Component; async `fetch('https://api.example.com/products', { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })`. `app/products/page.tsx`: await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`; `Suspense`, `ProductList`, `ProductListSkeleton`, `FilterSidebar`; `sort?: 'price' | 'name' | 'date'`, `category`, `page`. `components/products/ProductList.tsx`: colocated async fetch, `fetch(..., { next: { tags: ['products'] } })`, throw `new Error('Failed to fetch products')` when `!res.ok`; grid, `ProductCard`, `Pagination`. `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: `useState`, `useTransition`, `addToCart` from `@/app/actions/cart`. `app/actions/cart.ts`: `revalidateTag` from `"next/cache"`, `cookies` from `"next/headers"`, `redirect` from `"next/navigation"`; session cookie, `db.cart.upsert`; `{ success: true }`/`{ error: "Failed to add item to cart" }`; `checkout(formData: FormData)` validates `address`/`payment`, `processOrder`, `redirect(\`/orders/${order.id}/confirmation\`)`. `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`: slots `analytics`/`team`, grid with main/two asides; slot pages use `getAnalytics`/`getTeamMembers`, each `loading.tsx`. Photo modal: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx` intercepts; `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx` full page; await `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`/`getPhoto(id)`; `Modal`, `PhotoDetail`, `RelatedPhotos`; layout may accept `modal: React.ReactNode`. `app/product/[id]/page.tsx`: await `params`; blocking product, then stream `Reviews`/`Recommendations` in separate `<Suspense>` boundaries w
